In this package, you are able to use a linear regression model using ordinary least squares.

This vignette will go though how the package works, what is available and the possibilities 
a user has.

## Use case
```{r setup}
library(Lab4PKG)
data(iris)
estimation <- linreg(Petal.Length ~ Species, iris)
estimation
```
```{r}
estimation$plot()
```
